value.rationale: The sharp zero-epicyclic-frequency orbit is a physically motivated singular boundary of a screened gravitational two-body model. Its nonlinear stabilization as a strict quartic minimum, universal divergent radial-cycle winding and quantified 3/2-power three-orbit window are nontrivial dynamical quantities beyond a textbook stability sign computation; they delimit all angular-momentum windows with two stable circles. Astrophysical realism and historical priority limits are explicit.
